name: Saltmaw Shrike

Actions.name: Multiattack
Actions.text: The saltmaw shrike makes two Claw attacks.

Actions.name: Claw
Actions.text: *Melee Attack Roll:* +7, reach 5 ft. 22 (4d8 + 4) Slashing damage.

Actions.name: Erupting Ambush (Recharge 5-6)
Actions.text: If the saltmaw shrike is burrowing, it erupts from the ground at a point within 5 feet of one creature. *Dexterity Saving Throw*: DC 15, that creature. *Failure:* 42 (12d6) Bludgeoning damage, and the target has the Prone condition. The saltmaw shrike then makes one Claw attack against the target. *Success:* Half damage only.
Actions.minorClause: , and the target has the Prone condition

Bonus Actions.name: Umbral Step
Bonus Actions.text: While in Dim Light or Darkness, the saltmaw shrike takes the Hide action.

Traits.name: Splintering Strike
Traits.text: When the saltmaw shrike hits a creature with its Claw attack, The struck creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn as the lodged shard grinds against bone.

Traits.expressedQuote: When the saltmaw shrike hits a creature with its Claw attack, The struck creature has Disadvantage on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn as the lodged shard grinds against bone.

lore: A shrike grown from the grit of a dead salt flat, crowned with a buried dagger of petrified bone, it haunts the dune-shadows and waits — motionless — for a footfall it can answer within the same breath.

generation.userConcept: a sand-shrike that is only dangerous on the turn after it goes still
